interactive control (slider, column picker, or similar) — all three zones present in a single compact bar","Look for: the preview content area rendered DARKER than its frame (ground darker than panel), creating a recessed-instrument reading: the frame housing is warmer/lighter, the output well is deeper","The frame border should be a hairline (1px) — the window reads as an incision in the layout, not a card floating above it — 2px radius or less","REJECT if: the frame is a realistic macOS/Windows chrome illustration, if it uses drop-shadow or glow to lift it, if the dots use actual traffic-light red/yellow/green fills, or if the terminal is used as a decorative hero element"]},"acceptNuance":["Single-accent discipline: accept reference UIs where the accent color is NOT amber but is used with the same semantic restraint — one warm-tone accent (ochre, brass, gold, burnt orange) applied only to active state, CTA, and sequence markers, never as background fill or decoration","Grid substrate signal: accept references that show a very faint engineering grid or micro-texture as a page background even if barely visible — this substrate is a load-bearing impeccable cue indicating instrument-grade intent, not minimalism","Three-family typographic jurisdiction: prioritize references that visibly commit three font families to three distinct roles (display for headlines, humanist sans for body, mono for code/labels/status) with NO overlap — the family is the role","Hairline-only separation: accept references that divide sections exclusively with 1px rules and opacity shifts — no filled dividers, no section backgrounds, no shadow-based z-separation; the layout is flat and the rules do the work","Near-zero radius: treat 2px radius as the aesthetic ceiling — any reference using pill-shaped components, large rounded cards (>8px), or capsule-heavy layouts should be REJECTED even if the palette is otherwise correct"]}
```
